11  Fitting models

  • Show All Code
  • Hide All Code

Estimate parameters for a configured collection of models, save the fit records, optionally simulate responses, and compare those responses with the observations. A one-entry collection is a single-model work unit.

11.1 Parameters and setup

4 — Define feature loading and model construction 
def load_features(spec):
    semantic = np.load(resolve_project_path(spec["embedding_path"], root_path)) if spec.get("embedding_path") else None
    categorical = (
        np.load(resolve_project_path(spec["emotion_feature_path"], root_path))[
            :,
            int(spec.get("feature_column", 6)) : int(spec.get("feature_column", 6)) + 1,
        ]
        if spec.get("emotion_feature_path")
        else None
    )
    if spec.get("concat_features", False):
        return np.concatenate([categorical, semantic], axis=1)
    return categorical if categorical is not None else semantic


def construct_model(spec):
    return import_from_string(spec["model_factory"])(
        **{name: import_from_string(path) for name, path in spec["components"].items()}
    )

6 — Define saved-fit compatibility checks 
def check_saved_fit(fit_record, configuration, simulation_function, model_name):
    """Check a saved fit before reusing it and fill accepted older metadata."""
    parameters = configuration["parameters"]
    search_settings = configuration["search_settings"]
    selected_rows = configuration["selected_trial_indices"]
    pooled = configuration["pooled"]
    saved = fit_record.get("fit_configuration", {})
    # Older records omit exact rows in this nested object and display-only options.
    saved = {
        **saved,
        "selected_trial_indices": fit_record.get("selected_trial_indices", []),
    }
    saved.setdefault(
        "jax_enable_x64",
        fit_record.get("implementation", {}).get("jax_enable_x64", True),
    )
    recorded_search = dict(saved.get("search_settings", {}))
    current_search = dict(search_settings)
    for option in ("progress_bar", "display_iterations"):
        recorded_search.pop(option, None)
        current_search.pop(option, None)
    saved["search_settings"] = recorded_search
    expected_configuration = {**configuration, "search_settings": current_search}
    # Older fits have no source fingerprint; their objective is still recalculated.
    if "source_sha256" not in saved:
        expected_configuration.pop("source_sha256", None)
    if fit_record.get("fit_configuration") and saved != expected_configuration:
        raise ValueError(
            f"{model_name}: saved fit has different settings; use a new run tag or redo_fits=True."
        )
    if fit_record["free"] != parameters["free"]:
        raise ValueError(f"{model_name}: saved free parameters or bounds differ.")
    for key, value in parameters["fixed"].items():
        if key not in parameters["free"] and not np.all(
            np.asarray(fit_record["fits"][key]) == value
        ):
            raise ValueError(f"{model_name}: saved fixed parameter {key} differs.")
    if (
        "selected_trial_indices" in fit_record
        and sorted(fit_record["selected_trial_indices"]) != selected_rows
    ):
        raise ValueError(f"{model_name}: saved observation rows differ.")
    for key in ("model_factory", "components", "loss_function", "data_sha256"):
        if key in fit_record and fit_record[key] != configuration[key]:
            raise ValueError(f"{model_name}: saved {key} differs.")
    # Older project records can be read after checking their metadata and objective.
    for key in ("model_factory", "components", "loss_function", "data_sha256"):
        fit_record.setdefault(key, configuration[key])
    fit_record.setdefault("simulation_function", simulation_function)
    fit_record.setdefault("fit_configuration", configuration)
    fit_record.setdefault("pooled", pooled)
    return fit_record
7 — Define simulation-cache comparison 
def simulation_matches(saved_metadata, expected_configuration):
    """Compare the scientific settings, accepting the older provenance layout."""
    saved_metadata = dict(saved_metadata)
    implementation = saved_metadata.get("implementation", {})
    for key in ("jaxcmr_version", "jax_enable_x64"):
        saved_metadata.setdefault(key, implementation.get(key))
    return all(
        saved_metadata.get(key) == value
        for key, value in expected_configuration.items()
    )

8 — Select the participant work unit and observation trials 
data_tag = data_tag or data_path.stem

    subject_ids = subject_ids[:max_subjects]

    data["subject"].ravel(), subject_ids
)

    subject_ids = subject_ids[np.asarray(subject_indices, dtype=int)]
comparison_mask = cohort_mask & jnp.isin(data["subject"].ravel(), subject_ids)
selected_rows = np.flatnonzero(np.asarray(comparison_mask)).tolist()
if not selected_rows:
    raise ValueError("The configured selection contains no observations.")
if not model_configs:
    raise ValueError("Supply at least one model configuration.")

11 — Prepare model-specific filenames and fit configurations 
fit_paths, simulation_paths, selections, fit_configurations = {}, {}, {}, {}
fitter_class = import_from_string(fit_alg_path)
loss_class = import_from_string(loss_fn_path)
for model_name, model_spec in model_configs.items():
    parameter_config = model_spec["parameters"]
    features = load_features(model_spec)
    search_settings = {
        **fit_hyperparams,
        "seed": model_spec["seed"],
        "bounds": parameter_config["free"],
    }
    run_tag = f"{base_run_tag}_best_of_{search_settings.get('best_of', 1)}"
    if max_subjects:
        run_tag += f"_nsubs_{max_subjects}"
    model_run_stem = f"{data_tag}_{model_name}_{run_tag}"
    stem = model_spec.get("output_stem", model_run_stem)
    if subject_indices:
        stem += "_sub" + "_".join(str(index) for index in subject_indices)
    fit_path = fit_dir / f"{stem}.json"
    if fit_path in fit_paths.values():
        raise ValueError("Each model needs a distinct output_stem.")
    fit_paths[model_name] = fit_path
    simulation_paths[model_name] = simulation_dir / f"{stem}.h5"
    selections[model_name] = comparison_mask
    configuration = {
        "source_sha256": provenance["source_fingerprint"],
        "data_sha256": data_sha256,
        "selected_trial_indices": selected_rows,
        "cohort_trial_indices": np.flatnonzero(np.asarray(cohort_mask)).tolist(),
        "model_factory": model_spec["model_factory"],
        "components": model_spec["components"],
        "loss_function": loss_fn_path,
        "fit_algorithm": fit_alg_path,
        "parameters": parameter_config,
        "search_settings": search_settings,
        "pooled": pooled,
        "feature_sha256": hashlib.sha256(features.tobytes()).hexdigest()
        if features is not None
        else None,
        "jax_enable_x64": enable_x64,
    }
    fit_configurations[model_name] = configuration

11.3 Fit and recalculate the objectives

12 — Prepare metadata for newly fitted records 
fit_metadata = {}
for model_name, model_spec in model_configs.items():
    configuration = fit_configurations[model_name]
    search_settings = configuration["search_settings"]
    stem = fit_paths[model_name].stem
    run_tag = f"{base_run_tag}_best_of_{search_settings.get('best_of', 1)}"
    if max_subjects:
        run_tag += f"_nsubs_{max_subjects}"
    fit_metadata[model_name] = {
        "name": stem,
        "provenance": provenance,
        "model": model_name,
        "label": display_labels[model_name],
        "pooled": pooled,
        "data_tag": data_tag,
        "data_query": trial_query,
        "trial_query": trial_query,
        "run_tag": run_tag,
        "data_sha256": data_sha256,
        "selected_trial_indices": selected_rows,
        "cohort_trial_indices": configuration["cohort_trial_indices"],
        "model_factory": model_spec["model_factory"],
        "components": model_spec["components"],
        "loss_function": loss_fn_path,
        "fit_algorithm": fit_alg_path,
        "simulation_function": sim_alg_path,
        "fit_configuration": configuration,
        "jaxcmr_version": jaxcmr.__version__,
        "jax_version": jax.__version__,
        "jax_enable_x64": enable_x64,
        "embedding_path": model_spec.get("embedding_path", ""),
        "emotion_feature_path": model_spec.get("emotion_feature_path", ""),
        "feature_column": model_spec.get("feature_column", 6),
        "concat_features": model_spec.get("concat_features", False),
        "simulation_seed": simulation_seed,
        "simulation_repetitions": experiment_count,
    }
13 — Fit or load, recalculate the objective and save each model 
records = {}
fitted_now = set()
recalculated_objectives = {}
for model_name, model_spec in model_configs.items():
    parameter_config = model_spec["parameters"]
    model_factory = construct_model(model_spec)
    features = load_features(model_spec)
    configuration = fit_configurations[model_name]
    search_settings = configuration["search_settings"]
    fit_path = fit_paths[model_name]
    if redo_fits or not fit_path.exists():
        fitter = fitter_class(
            data,
            features,
            parameter_config["fixed"],
            model_factory,
            loss_class,
            hyperparams=search_settings,
        )
        actual_subjects = np.unique(subjects[selected_rows])
        if pooled:
            fit_record = fitter.fit(comparison_mask, subject_id=-1)
        elif len(actual_subjects) == 1:
            fit_record = fitter.fit(comparison_mask, subject_id=int(actual_subjects[0]))
        else:
            fit_record = fitter.fit_subjects(comparison_mask)
        fitted_now.add(model_name)
    else:
        fit_record = json.loads(fit_path.read_text())
        fit_record = check_saved_fit(
            fit_record, configuration, sim_alg_path, model_name
        )
    expected_subjects = [-1] if pooled else np.unique(subjects[selected_rows]).tolist()
    if sorted(fit_record["fits"]["subject"]) != expected_subjects:
        raise ValueError(
            f"{model_name}: fit rows do not match the selected participants."
        )

    # Evaluate the returned physical parameters independently of optimizer state.
    loss = loss_class(model_factory, data, features)
    free_parameter_names = tuple(parameter_config["free"])
    recalculated = []
    for subject_index, subject_id in enumerate(fit_record["fits"]["subject"]):
        subject_trials = (
            comparison_mask
            if pooled
            else comparison_mask & (data["subject"].ravel() == subject_id)
        )
        evaluate = make_scipy_loss_fn(
            loss,
            jnp.flatnonzero(subject_trials),
            parameter_config["fixed"],
            free_parameter_names,
        )
        free_parameter_values = jnp.asarray(
            [fit_record["fits"][key][subject_index] for key in free_parameter_names]
        )
        recalculated.append(float(evaluate(free_parameter_values)))
    if not np.allclose(fit_record["fitness"], recalculated, rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-5):
        raise ValueError(
            f"{model_name}: returned objective disagrees with recalculation."
        )
    if model_name in fitted_now:
        fit_record.update(fit_metadata[model_name])
        fit_record["recomputed_objective"] = recalculated
        if loss_fn_path.endswith("ExcludeTerminationLikelihoodLoss") and pooled:
            fit_record["recomputed_nll"] = recalculated[0]
        fit_path.write_text(json.dumps(fit_record, indent=2) + "\n")
    records[model_name] = fit_record
    recalculated_objectives[model_name] = recalculated
14 — Display fitted parameters and independently recalculated objectives 
for model_name, fit_record in records.items():
    fit_path = fit_paths[model_name]
    free_parameter_names = tuple(model_configs[model_name]["parameters"]["free"])
    recalculated = recalculated_objectives[model_name]
    print(display_labels[model_name], "—", fit_path)
    print(
        tabulate(
            {
                key: fit_record["fits"][key]
                for key in ["subject", *free_parameter_names]
            },
            headers="keys",
            floatfmt=".5g",
        )
    )
    print(
        tabulate(
            zip(fit_record["fits"]["subject"], fit_record["fitness"], recalculated),
            headers=["Subject", "Reported objective", "Recalculated"],
            floatfmt=".6f",
        )
    )
print("fit_paths =", {model_name: str(path) for model_name, path in fit_paths.items()})

11.4 Generate responses

15 — Prepare participant parameters and response provenance 
simulation_inputs = {}
for model_name, fit_record in records.items():
    if not (redo_sims or redo_figures):
        continue
    model_factory = construct_model(fit_record)
    features = load_features(fit_record)
    selected_trials = selections[model_name]
    is_pooled = fit_record.get("pooled", fit_record["fits"]["subject"] == [-1])
    participant_ids = jnp.unique(data["subject"].ravel()[selected_trials])
    subject_parameters = {
        key: jnp.asarray(values) for key, values in fit_record["fits"].items()
    }
    if is_pooled:
        subject_parameters = {
            key: jnp.repeat(values, len(participant_ids))
            for key, values in subject_parameters.items()
            if key != "subject"
        }
        subject_parameters["subject"] = participant_ids
    fixed = (
        fit_record.get("fit_configuration", {})
        .get("parameters", {})
        .get("fixed", fit_record["fixed"])
    )
    for key, value in fixed.items():
        if isinstance(value, bool):
            subject_parameters[key] = subject_parameters[key].astype(bool)
    configuration = {
        "provenance": provenance,
        "fits": fit_record["fits"],
        "pooled": is_pooled,
        "jax_enable_x64": enable_x64,
        "jaxcmr_version": jaxcmr.__version__,
        "model_factory": fit_record["model_factory"],
        "components": fit_record["components"],
        "simulation_function": fit_record["simulation_function"],
        "data_sha256": data_sha256,
        "selected_trial_indices": np.flatnonzero(np.asarray(selected_trials)).tolist(),
        "feature_sha256": hashlib.sha256(features.tobytes()).hexdigest()
        if features is not None
        else None,
        "seed": simulation_seed,
        "experiment_count": experiment_count,
    }
    simulation_inputs[model_name] = {
        "model_factory": model_factory,
        "features": features,
        "parameters": subject_parameters,
        "trial_mask": selected_trials,
        "configuration": configuration,
    }
16 — Generate or reuse matching responses and save them 
simulations = {}
for model_name, prepared in simulation_inputs.items():
    model_factory = prepared["model_factory"]
    features = prepared["features"]
    subject_parameters = prepared["parameters"]
    selected_trials = prepared["trial_mask"]
    configuration = prepared["configuration"]
    simulation_path = simulation_paths[model_name]
    metadata_path = simulation_path.with_suffix(".json")
    saved_metadata = (
        json.loads(metadata_path.read_text()) if metadata_path.exists() else {}
    )
    reuse_responses = (
        not redo_sims
        and model_name not in fitted_now
        and simulation_path.exists()
        and metadata_path.exists()
        and simulation_matches(saved_metadata, configuration)
    )
    if reuse_responses:
        simulated = load_data(str(simulation_path))
        print("Loaded matching responses:", simulation_path)
    else:
        simulated = simulate_h5_from_h5(
            model_factory,
            data,
            features,
            subject_parameters,
            selected_trials,
            experiment_count=experiment_count,
            rng=jax.random.PRNGKey(simulation_seed),
            simulate_trial_fn=import_from_string(configuration["simulation_function"]),
        )
        simulation_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        save_dict_to_hdf5(simulated, str(simulation_path))
        metadata_path.write_text(
            json.dumps(
                {
                    **configuration,
                    "jaxcmr_version": jaxcmr.__version__,
                    "jax_version": jax.__version__,
                },
                indent=2,
            )
            + "\n"
        )
        print("Saved responses:", simulation_path)
    if filter_repeated_recalls:
        simulated = dict(simulated)
        simulated["recalls"] = repetition.filter_repeated_recalls(simulated["recalls"])
    simulations[model_name] = simulated
print(
    "simulation_paths =",
    {model_name: str(path) for model_name, path in simulation_paths.items()},
)

11.5 Compare behavior

17 — Prepare configured model and observation comparisons 
comparison_groups = []
if redo_figures and simulations:
    observed = dict(data)
    if filter_repeated_recalls:
        observed["recalls"] = repetition.filter_repeated_recalls(observed["recalls"])
    datasets = [observed, *simulations.values()]
    names = ["Observed", *[display_labels[name] for name in simulations]]
    comparison_groups.append(
        {
            "analyses": comparison_analysis_configs,
            "datasets": datasets,
            "labels": names,
            "suffix": "",
        }
    )
    for dataset_index, (dataset, label) in enumerate(zip(datasets, names)):
        comparison_groups.append(
            {
                "analyses": single_analysis_configs,
                "datasets": [dataset],
                "labels": [label],
                "suffix": f"_single_{dataset_index}",
            }
        )
18 — Plot and save the configured benchmarks 
for group in comparison_groups:
    analysis_configs = group["analyses"]
    panel_data = group["datasets"]
    curve_labels = group["labels"]
    figure_suffix = group["suffix"]
    for analysis_index, analysis_config in enumerate(analysis_configs):
        plotter = import_from_string(analysis_config["target"])
        masks = [
            generate_trial_mask(
                dataset, analysis_config.get("trial_query", analysis_trial_query)
            )
            for dataset in panel_data
        ]
        masks = [
            trial_mask & comparison_mask if dataset is observed else trial_mask
            for dataset, trial_mask in zip(panel_data, masks)
        ]
        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=analysis_config.get("figsize", figure_size))
        plot_options = {
            "labels": analysis_config.get("labels", curve_labels),
            "contrast_name": analysis_config.get("contrast_name", "Responses"),
            "confidence_level": confidence_level,
            "axis": ax,
            **analysis_config.get("kwargs", {}),
        }
        if analysis_config.get("color_cycle") is not None:
            plot_options["color_cycle"] = analysis_config["color_cycle"]
        plotter(panel_data, masks, **plot_options)
        ax.set_title(analysis_config.get("title", plotter.__name__))
        if analysis_config.get("ylim") is not None:
            ax.set_ylim(analysis_config["ylim"])
        suffix = (
            analysis_config.get("figure_suffix", plotter.__name__.removeprefix("plot_"))
            + figure_suffix
        )
        if (
            sum(
                other["target"] == analysis_config["target"]
                for other in analysis_configs
            )
            > 1
            and "figure_suffix" not in analysis_config
        ):
            suffix += f"_{analysis_index + 1}"
        save_figure(str(figure_dir), figure_str, suffix=suffix, formats=figure_formats)
